hooks.text: 三名英雄各自携带独立牌组与战斗风格
hooks.excerpt: Three unique playable heroes, each with their own deck of battle cards and fighting style

opinions.text: 可用角色的平衡较差，玩家只觉得一个角色真正可行。

excerpts.excerpt: I only ever found one character to be really viable to play as

excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: that's about the only original idea I see brought to the table

opinions.text: 难以理解的随机死亡带来强烈挫败感。
